scoring_justification: Compute-driven simulation; exact numeric values depend on random seed and implementation details, making a fixed gold table infeasible. Structural checks verify that the submitted raw time series exhibit the characteristic dynamical behavior (damped oscillations, 1/sqrt(N) fluctuation scaling, exponential decay) consistent with the physical model.

outputs.description: Magnetization time series for τ=0, L=100; checked for damped oscillation and steady-state mean.
Magnetization standard deviation vs. system size; checked for power-law scaling slope ≈ -1 and high R².
Buyer fraction time series for τ=∞; checked for exponential decay after initial transient.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are CSV time series or summary tables. Scoring is structural: the verifier checks oscillations, steady-state mean, log-log scaling of fluctuations, and exponential decay. No gold numeric values are required in the task instruction.
